reviewed_by: Codex review of daily stable release source parity and immutable version handling
reason: The daily Linux release driver must use an unused version after a failed immutable tag and stop publication if main advances after candidate preparation. The focused release-driver contract file covers those boundaries, dispatches, receipts, artifacts, and failure handling.
exclusions: No product UI, Core API, native code, or Playwright catalog changes; frontend, native, browser, and unrelated Python suites are excluded. The external packaging and installation gates still require a new candidate run.
